# Isaiah Chapter 60 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 22 verses]*

*Light dawns; nations come; wealth flows in; sun no more needed; God is everlasting light*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 60 (The Glory of Zion) addresses light dawns; nations come; wealth flows in; sun no more needed; god is everlasting light. The key verse — "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen upon you" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Third Isaiah (chs. 56-66), focused on the restored community and eschatological hope.
